changeLog.change: Explicitly approved admin-created driver trip from Dispatch; no driver impersonation, automatic order assignment or GPS consent. No new mobile binary.

Admin creates actual duty trip with their own audited authority and password, explicit optional on-duty availability and location consent false. Eight reviewed shared web/rule continuations, two new runtime modules, no schema/native changes. 48 focused checks including real PostgreSQL17 races and six local actual-browser cases pass. Hosted rollout/full CI pending.
